opening: bring a cloak. the roads get strange from here.
note: Decision 88: the door runs on the labels (the labels file, data/labels.json). One question, its kinds, then "anything". A film sits under every kind it is labelled with, at most two; a film not yet labelled waits behind the door under "anything" and "Just pick one!" only. A kind under 30 films in the library is not offered.

questions.ask: which kind of magic are we after?

options.say: swords, sorcery, and dragons. a whole other world.
fairy tales. princesses, curses, and enchanted kingdoms.
magic in our world. wizards, ghosts, and wonders next door.
options.reply: keep an eye on the wardrobe.

options.say: superheroes. gods, sorcerers, and capes with magic in them.
anything. just take me somewhere enchanted.

superheroes.note: shared with the action and scifi and animation doors, so a film behind both holds it at both or neither.
